title: CombinedProposal
description: A single atomic proposal (HEL-387) combining a PipelineProposal and a DashboardProposal — applying it creates the pipeline's resolved source (if inline)/pipeline/steps/run AND the dashboard/panels in one transaction, resolving the pipeline's not-yet-created output DataType id into the dashboard's panel bindings. A dashboard data panel binds to this call's own pipeline by setting its `dataTypeId` (or, for a non-data panel, `config.dataTypeId`) to the reserved sentinel string "$pipelineOutput" — the exact same slot DashboardProposal already uses for a real DataType id. The sentinel must appear in AT MOST the one blessed slot for that panel's kind (the flat `dataTypeId` if set to the sentinel; otherwise `config.dataTypeId` only for a panel type outside `output` (i.e. text/markdown/image), and only when the flat `dataTypeId` is absent) — any other occurrence (a kind-mismatched slot, a slot shadowed by an already-set flat field, a duplicate elsewhere such as `fieldMapping`) is rejected with a 400 naming the panel, before anything is created. A panel that omits the sentinel keeps whatever `dataTypeId` it already had, so a combined proposal may mix panels bound to this call's new pipeline with panels bound to pre-existing types.
